question: 'We have wings' is associated with which of the following sports events?
solution:
The correct answer is Paralympic 2020.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** 2020 Summer Paralympics:-**

 
 
• It was originally scheduled to be held in Tokyo, Japan, were postponed to 2021 due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
 
• They are now officially known as the "Tokyo 2020 Paralympic Games," even though they were held in 2021.
 
• The event took place from August 24 to September 5, 2021.
 
• **'We have wings' is associated with this.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **2016 Summer Olympics:-**

 
 
• It is officially known as the Games of the XXXI Olympiad, were held in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, from August 5 to August 21, 2016.
 
• These Olympics featured a wide range of sports and showcased the talent of athletes from around the world. 
 
 
 
• **2020 Summer Olympics:-**
 
 
• It is officially known as the Games of the XXXII Olympiad, were originally scheduled to be held in Tokyo, Japan, from July 24 to August 9, 2020.
 
• However, due to the COVID-19 pandemic, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) and the Tokyo 2020 Organizing Committee made the unprecedented decision to postpone the Games to 2021.
 
• The rescheduled dates for the Tokyo 2020 Olympics were July 23 to August 8, 2021.
